name: command-block
title: Command palette block
description: A ⌘K command palette in a native dialog: fuzzy search over grouped commands, an ARIA combobox and listbox, recent items, nested pages, loading and empty states, keyboard hints and a highlight that slides by CSS anchor positioning. Made of the Rabtx components. CSS-only motion.

.rx-command-highlight.transition: top var(--spring-unfold-duration) var(--spring-unfold), right var(--spring-unfold-duration) var(--spring-unfold), bottom var(--spring-unfold-duration) var(--spring-unfold), left var(--spring-unfold-duration) var(--spring-unfold)
